description: This file implements ALSA PCM audio interface functions for Android, including device initialization, parameter setup, read/write operations, and error handling, specifically for the 'crespo' device in the Samsung platform.

methods.name: pcm_open
methods.description: Initializes and opens an ALSA PCM device with specified flags and parameters.

methods.name: pcm_close
methods.description: Closes the PCM device and releases resources.

methods.name: pcm_write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the PCM device.

methods.name: pcm_read
methods.description: Reads audio data from the PCM device.

methods.name: pcm_ready
methods.description: Checks if the PCM device is ready for I/O.

methods.name: pcm_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message for the PCM device.

methods.name: pcm_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the buffer size of the PCM device.
